name: Jehu
summary: An army captain anointed king over Israel to wipe out Ahab's family line. He wiped Baal worship out of Israel, but kept the golden calves at Bethel and Dan.

key_moments.title: Anointed in Secret
key_moments.description: A young prophet sent by Elisha took Jehu into an inner room at Ramoth-gilead and anointed him with oil, saying the LORD had made him king over Israel. His fellow captains blew trumpets and cried that Jehu was king.

key_moments.title: He Drives Furiously
key_moments.description: Jehu raced his chariot to Jezreel so wildly that the watchman knew who it was. When King Joram came out to meet him, Jehu shot him through the heart.

key_moments.title: Jezebel's End
key_moments.description: At Jezreel, Jehu called to the servants at a window, and they threw Jezebel down. Later, when her body was looked for, almost nothing was left, as the LORD had said through Elijah.

key_moments.title: Baal Destroyed from Israel
key_moments.description: Jehu called everyone who worshipped Baal to a great sacrifice in Baal's temple, then had his guards kill them. Baal's temple and image were broken down.

key_moments.title: A Divided Heart
key_moments.description: The LORD promised that Jehu's sons would sit on Israel's throne to the fourth generation. Yet Jehu took no care to follow the LORD's law wholeheartedly, and he kept the golden calves at Bethel and Dan.
